ayahs.textEnglish: CONSIDER the daybreak
and the ten nights!
Consider the multiple and the One!
Consider the night as it runs its course!

ayahs.textArabic: هَلْ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِيْ حِجْرٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Hal fī żālika qasamul liżī ḥijr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Considering all this - could there be, to anyone endowed with reason, a [more] solemn evidence of the truth?

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara kaifa fa‘ala rabbuka bi‘ād(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: ART THOU NOT aware of how thy Sustainer has dealt with [the tribe of] ‘Ad,
[the people of] Iram the many-pillared,

ayahs.textArabic: الَّتِيْ لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى الْبِلَادِۖ
ayahs.textEnglish: the like of whom has never been reared in all the land? –
and with [the tribe of] Thamud, who hollowed out rocks in the valley? –
and with Pharaoh of the [many] tent-poles?
[It was they] who transgressed all bounds of equity all over their lands,
and brought about great corruption therein:
and therefore thy Sustainer let loose upon them a scourge of suffering:
for, verily, thy Sustainer is ever on the watch!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَمَّا الْاِنْسَانُ اِذَا مَا ابْتَلٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ فَاَكْرَمَهٗ وَنَعَّمَهٗۙ فَيَقُوْلُ رَبِّيْٓ اَكْرَمَنِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ammal-insānu iżā mabtalāhu rabbuhū fa akramahū wa na‘‘amah(ū), fa yaqūlu rabbī akraman(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: BUT AS FOR man, whenever his Sustainer tries him by His generosity and by letting him enjoy a life of ease, he says, "My Sustainer has been [justly] generous towards me";

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّآ اِذَا مَا ابْتَلٰىهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهٗ ەۙ فَيَقُوْلُ رَبِّيْٓ اَهَانَنِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammā iżā mabtalāhu fa qadara ‘alaihi rizqah(ū), fa yaqūlu rabbī ahānan(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereas, whenever He tries him by straitening his means of livelihood, he says, "My Sustainer has disgraced me!"
But nay, nay, [O men, consider all that you do and fail to do:] you are not generous towards the orphan,
and you do not urge one another to feed the needy,
and you devour the inheritance [of others] with devouring greed,
and you love wealth with boundless love!

ayahs.textArabic: كَلَّآ اِذَا دُكَّتِ الْاَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّاۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay, but [how will you fare on Judgment Day,] when the earth is crushed with crushing upon crushing,

ayahs.textLatin: Wa jā'a rabbuka wal-malaku ṣaffan ṣaffā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [the majesty of] thy Sustainer stands revealed, as well as [the true nature of] the angels; rank upon rank?

ayahs.textArabic: وَجِايْۤءَ يَوْمَىِٕذٍۢ بِجَهَنَّمَۙ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّتَذَكَّرُ الْاِنْسَانُ وَاَنّٰى لَهُ الذِّكْرٰىۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jī'a yauma'iżim bijahannam(a), yauma'iżiy yatażakkarul-insānu wa annā lahuż-żikrā.
ayahs.textEnglish: And on that Day hell will be brought [within sight]; on that Day man will remember [all that he did and failed to do]: but what will that remembrance avail him?
He will say, "Oh, would that I had. provided beforehand for my life [to come]!"
For, none can make suffer as He will make suffer [the sinners] on that Day,
and none can bind with bonds like His.
[But unto the righteous God will say,] "O thou human being that hast attained to inner peace!
Return thou unto thy Sustainer, well-pleased [and] pleasing [Him]:
enter, then, together with My [other true] servants –
yea, enter thou My paradise!"
